notes: לָכֵן is a compound of preposition and adverb rendered by one word; neither morpheme carries content the other lacks, so the head goes to the governing morpheme standing first (rule 23), the competing reading heading on כֵן.
The complementizer that after I said indeed is supplied for a clause with no conjunction morpheme in it (rule 55).
Be it far keeps the impersonal it inside the interjection's own fixed rendering (rule 20); shall be lightly esteemed heads on lightly, the competing reading heading on esteemed.
